description: Put a scene live: every screen and sub-screen in the scene switches at once, in place of what it shows. Running it again puts changes to the scene live. A screen only shows the scene once it is online and has a player paired; each result includes online and paired when the connection may read screens.

scene_id.description: Id of the scene, as listed with the team's scenes.
